quarterly_data.signal: Everpure's results release for the second quarter of fiscal 2027 (ended August 2, 2026): total revenue $1.2 billion, up 38% year over year, the eighth straight quarter of accelerating revenue growth according to the CEO.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $1.2 billion (+38% YoY) - Q2 FY2027 ended August 2, 2026

quarterly_data.signal: At the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2027 (ended August 2, 2026) Everpure reported subscription annual recurring revenue (ARR) of $2.1 billion, up 20% year over year, and remaining performance obligations (RPO) of $4.1 billion, up 44% year over year.
quarterly_data.figure: ARR $2.1 billion (+20% YoY); RPO $4.1 billion (+44% YoY) - end of Q2 FY2027

quarterly_data.signal: Everpure guided third quarter fiscal 2027 revenue to $1.325B to $1.335B (37% to 38% year-over-year growth) and non-GAAP operating income to $265M to $275M, and raised full-year fiscal 2027 guidance: revenue $5.03B to $5.07B (37% to 38% growth) from $4.41B to $4.51B (20% to 23%), non-GAAP operating income $940M to $960M from $820M to $860M. The CFO said demand remains strong despite historic industry price increases in the first half of FY'27 and that guidance was raised significantly for the second half.
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 FY27 revenue $1.325B to $1.335B (37% to 38% YoY); FY27 revenue raised to $5.03B to $5.07B (37% to 38%) from $4.41B to $4.51B; FY27 non-GAAP operating income $940M to $960M (prior $820M to $860M)
